result.instructions: Tools for Azuga, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which drivers had the most harsh-braking events this month? Show their fleet scores."; "Show me the events on trip 561TRP12 and where each one happened."; "Where is each vehicle right now, and which ones are idling?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Azuga data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run azuga_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run azuga_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run azuga_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. azuga_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: azuga_get_profile
tools.title: Get profile
tools.description: Get the signed-in Azuga user's profile: user name, device, vehicle, fleet score, reward counts and privileges. Also the cheapest authenticated call. Azuga: GET /profile/info.json.

averageDays.description: Days to average the score over (for example 30).

lastSyncTime.description: Return changes since this epoch-millisecond time.

tools.name: azuga_list_driver_scores
tools.title: List driver scores
tools.description: List driver scores with rank, fleet score, and the speeding, braking, hard-acceleration and idling sub-scores. Per driver, not per group. Azuga: GET /score/list.json.

startIndex.description: Index of the first driver to return.

tools.name: azuga_list_trips
tools.title: List trips
tools.description: List trips that started and ended between two times, with distance, duration and trip ids. Azuga: GET /trip/info.json.

fromDate.description: Trips starting at or after this epoch-millisecond time.

toDate.description: Trips ending at or before this epoch-millisecond time.

tools.name: azuga_get_trip_events
tools.title: Get trip events
tools.description: Get the driving events of one trip: hard braking, extreme braking, sudden acceleration, over-speeding and idling, with time, speed, location and fuel. Good first workflow for harsh-driving reviews. Azuga: GET /trip/eventdetail.json (reports host).

tools.name: azuga_list_events
tools.title: List vehicle events
tools.description: List fleet events for vehicles or groups between two times, for example speeding, idling or device events, with sorting and paging. Azuga: POST /events.json (read only).

fromDate.description: Events triggered at or after this time.

toDate.description: Events triggered at or before this time.

vehicleNames.description: Vehicle names. Give one of vehicleNames, vehicleIds, groupNames, groupIds.

vehicleIds.description: Vehicle ids. Give one of vehicleNames, vehicleIds, groupNames, groupIds.

groupNames.description: Group names. Give one of vehicleNames, vehicleIds, groupNames, groupIds.

groupIds.description: Group ids. Give one of vehicleNames, vehicleIds, groupNames, groupIds.

eventType.description: Comma-separated event types, for example Speeding,Idling.

sortCriteria.description: Sort order: ascending or descending (default ascending by event time).

startIndex.description: Index of the first result to return.

searchCriteria.description: Search one column for a value; ALL searches every column.

tools.name: azuga_list_live_locations
tools.title: List live vehicle status
tools.description: List the live status and last known location of vehicles, optionally filtered by vehicle or group. Azuga: GET /live/location.json.

tools.name: azuga_get_vehicle_location
tools.title: Get last vehicle location
tools.description: Get the last known location of one tracked user (username of the device holder). Azuga: GET /trackee/location/last.json?username=.

tools.name: azuga_list_vehicles
tools.title: List vehicles
tools.description: List vehicles with their names, ids, groups and device details. Filter by name, group or id. Azuga: GET /vehicle/view.json.

includeChildGroups.description: true or false: include vehicles of child groups.

lastSyncTime.description: Return changes since this epoch-millisecond time.

tools.name: azuga_list_drivers
tools.title: List drivers
tools.description: List users of the account of one type (default driver), with names, usernames and ids. Azuga: GET /users/view.json?type=.

tools.name: azuga_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List vehicle and driver groups, with ids and names. Azuga: GET /groups/view.json.

tools.name: azuga_list_geofences
tools.title: List geofences
tools.description: List geofences (virtual areas), with names and shapes. Filter by name or group. Azuga: GET /geofence/view.json.

tools.name: azuga_list_landmarks
tools.title: List landmarks
tools.description: List landmarks (points of interest), with names, types and addresses. Filter by name, group or type. Azuga: GET /landmark/view.json.

tools.name: azuga_get_breadcrumbs
tools.title: Get vehicle breadcrumb trail
tools.description: Get the GPS trail of one vehicle between two times, one point per recording, paged. Azuga: GET /breadcrumb/location.json.

localTime.description: Return times in the account's local time zone.

tools.name: azuga_list_pairing_history
tools.title: List device pairing history
tools.description: List which driver was paired with which vehicle or device, between two times. Azuga: GET /users/pairinghistory.json.

startTime.description: Start of the period, epoch milliseconds.

endTime.description: End of the period, epoch milliseconds.

noAssociations.description: Set to 1 to include pairings without an association.

tools.name: azuga_list_rewards
tools.title: List reward history
tools.description: List driver rewards between two times, with status (pending, processed or all). Azuga: GET /rewards/history.json.

fromDate.description: Start of the period, epoch milliseconds.

toDate.description: End of the period, epoch milliseconds.

status.description: Reward status: all, pending or processed.

tools.name: azuga_get_vehicle_diagnostics
tools.title: Get vehicle diagnostic trouble codes
tools.description: Get OBD diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs) reported by vehicles in a period, with code, definition, vehicle, location and time. Several vehicles per call. Azuga: POST /diagnostics.json (read only).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Azuga
prompts.description: What you can do with Azuga here, with example requests to try.
